findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "schedule_extraction" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a recurring schedule (hourly, daily or weekly) that re-runs one of the user's saved scrapes and delivers each run to email, a Google Sheet or a webhook. …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: youtube_search, youtube_channel_videos, youtube_comments, schedule_extraction · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_channel_videos, schedule_extraction · Destructive: lection_browser_tools_info, my_lection_account, get_run_results, list_my_schedules, schedule_extraction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: youtube_search, youtube_channel_videos, youtube_comments, schedule_extraction · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_channel_videos, schedule_extraction · Destructive: lection_browser_tools_info, my_lection_account, get_run_results, list_my_schedules, schedule_extraction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
